name: fr.valeur-intrinseque/valeur-intrinseque
title: Valeur Intrinsèque
description: Official Score VI MCP server: intrinsic value, fundamentals, and a stock screener.

tools.name: analyze_stock
tools.description:
Full fundamental snapshot for one ticker using Valeur Intrinsèque's Score VI.
Returns the company profile, the Score VI out of 100 with each scored criterion, and key ratios (EPS, P/E, ROE, debt/equity, dividend yield, current ratio, book value per share, P/B).
Prints a per-share intrinsic value and margin of safety only when the API payload already includes one.
Counts toward the monthly Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH, MC.PA)

tools.name: get_intrinsic_value
tools.description:
Published Score VI for one ticker, read from the public cache (no fresh full analysis).
Returns the score out of 100, a short interpretation, price, P/E, whether an eliminatory criterion failed, the calculation date, a citation and a disclaimer.
Does not list the ten criteria and does not return a per-share intrinsic value. Use analyze_stock for the criteria.
Counts toward the monthly Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH, MC.PA)

tools.name: get_financial_statements
tools.description:
Last five reported years of one financial statement: income, balance, or cashflow.
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH)

statement.description: Statement type: income (income statement), balance (balance sheet), or cashflow (cash flow statement)

tools.name: get_valuation_metrics
tools.description:
Year-end valuation multiples for one ticker. Shows every series the API actually has (P/E, P/S, P/FCF, P/OCF, and P/B, PEG, dividend yield, EV/EBITDA when the source publishes them).
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH)

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.description: Latest price and currency for one ticker or company name. Resolves names such as LVMH to MC.PA. Returns an MCP error with suggestions when the symbol is unknown or the price is missing/zero. Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH, MC.PA)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description:
Price-history summary for one ticker: first and last price, change, high, low, and the last 10 points.
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH)

tools.name: get_moat_score
tools.description:
Cached competitive-advantage (moat) score from 1 to 5 for one ticker.
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH)

tools.name: get_management_score
tools.description:
Cached management-quality score from 1 to 5 (track record, capital allocation, communication, shareholder alignment).
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

symbol.description: Stock ticker or company name (e.g. AAPL, LVMH)

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description:
Recently analyzed stocks ranked by Score VI, highest first.
Returns ticker, name, score and price. Does not filter by country, region or sector, and does not return a per-share intrinsic value.
Not counted in the Score VI quota.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description:
Side-by-side published Score VI for 2 to 8 tickers: score, price, P/E and name.
Reads the public cache and does not list the ten criteria.
Counts toward the monthly Score VI quota.

symbols.description: Tickers or company names to compare (2-8, e.g. ["AAPL","LVMH","MSFT"])
